Moving from the previous app? Export a complete local backup there, then restore it here. Include attachments to keep photos, recordings and files.

Semesta keeps your academic workspace in local storage. An account is optional. If you configure and link Google, cloud backup sends your academic backup to Firebase; binary attachments stay in your complete local backup. Notifications use local reminders. Update checks contact GitHub only when release infrastructure is configured. Recording uses the microphone only with your permission. Support opens your email app; you review and send the message. Use Data settings to export, restore or delete your local workspace.

Semesta helps you organize study, grades, schedules and expenses. Your institution remains the source of truth for grades, attendance and deadlines. Keep a complete local backup before changing devices or importing another workspace. Third-party library and font licenses are available below. Contact leoaristocratjr@gmail.com for product questions.
